description: Use when the user asks about Kamchatka transfers: whole-vehicle charters (vakhtovka, minibus, jeep), price per vehicle by destination or hour/day, not per seat. Request: request_charter. For how to get to a volcano, hot springs, a lake or the airport. Vedar sells no seats: the customer sets date and route, a Vedar manager confirms the vehicle with the carrier, payment goes to the carrier directly. Do not invent trips, seats or prices missing from the reply.

place.description: Destination or origin word from the question (volcano, lake, river, village); empty — the whole price list.
